### 2026-10-31: 11:00 - 4:30

**5.5h**

11:00 - 4:30

Installed more libraries for compatability (RTClib and TM1637)

This runs once at startup:
     - starts Serial output
    - configures encoder pins and button pin as INPUT_PULLUP
    - configures AM/PM LEDs as outputs
    - starts I2C on custom pins using Wire.begin(PIN_SDA, PIN_SCL)
    - starts the DHT sensor
    - sets initial brightness on the TM1637
    - initializes NeoPixels
    - starts the RTC
    - sets the RTC time to the compile time (computer's time) , but only if the thing shut off
    - stores the initial encoder A state
This repeats forever:
    - handleEncoder() checks rotation and changes brightness
    - handleButton() checks button presses and cycles display mode
    - updateDisplayAndLEDs() updates the TM1637 and AM/PM LEDs
    - updateRainbowBorder() animates the NeoPixel strip
Only calculates/ displays temperatures over 100 degrees celcius, but lets be real, I'd be dead before i got to read that it was that hot

Added segments to the brightness levels (increases by 25 everytime the rotary encoder turns)(7 different levels of brightness)

DHT11 doesn't show decimal temp, so i just show 23, space, then a c. Same for humidity

ALmost done BOM, but the overall price is way over the budget, might be impossible to get under 30 (Spent quite a while trying to find cheapest prices bruh)
